Good to know

Before you inquire

Are the buildings at the same location?

No. Peña Plaza includes two buildings at separate locations. Each has its own property details and availability.

Is space currently available?

Contact us to confirm vacancies at either building. Suite sizes, prices, and move-in dates are not currently published.

Where are the buildings?

Request the exact address for the building you are interested in and arrange an appointment before visiting.

Can I request a tour?

Yes. Choose “Request a tour” on the leasing inquiry form and tell us which building you would like to visit.
